title: Moving Least Squares without Quasi-Uniformity: A Stochastic Approach
summary: Local Polynomial Regression (LPR) and Moving Least Squares (MLS) are closely related nonparametric estimation methods, developed independently in statistics and approximation theory. While statistical LPR analysis focuses on overcoming sampling noise under probabilistic assumptions, the deterministic MLS theory studies smoothness properties and convergence rates with respect to the \textit{fill distance} (a resolution parameter).
